model_details.baseline: DummyClassifier(strategy='prior'): everyone gets the training prevalence
model_details.rf: make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(median), RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=3, random_state=0)). Note min_samples_leaf=3: last week's regression forest used the default of 1
model_details.gbm: LGBMClassifier(random_state=0): defaults (100 trees, learning rate 0.1, 31 leaves), missing values handled natively
model_details.tabicl: TabICLClassifier(random_state=0, device='cuda'): pretrained tabular foundation model, Apache-2.0, no tuning

splits.kfold: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0): same folds for every model
splits.group: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0): each patient's encounters stay in one fold
splits.dev_test: First fold of StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) is the locked 20% test set
